data.description: A Contemporary Oasis: Dawn by Binghatti in JVC
data.display_address: Binghatti Dawn, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
data.long_description:
Dawn by Binghatti is a contemporary 5-storey development located in the lively JVC community. Inspired by the serene beauty of dawn, this project offers a selection of furnished and unfurnished studios, as well as one and two-bedroom apartments. With a focus on high-quality craftsmanship and luxurious finishes, each unit is designed to create a harmonious living environment that blends comfort and style.

The development is equipped with a range of amenities designed to support an active and relaxed lifestyle. Residents have access to a well-equipped gym, a refreshing swimming pool, and tranquil spaces for unwinding.

Centrally positioned, Dawn by Binghatti offers excellent connectivity to key areas in Dubai, including Al Khail Road and Sheikh Zayed Road. Circle Mall is a short walk away, while Dubai Marina and Burj Al Arab are just a 15-minute drive. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa can be reached within 25-30 minutes, offering residents both convenience and accessibility.
